Lake Superior has something vaguely similar. The big island in Isle Royale National Park (an archipelago of ~200 tiny rocky islands) has Siskiwit Lake, and its biggest island is Ryan Island which, when the snow melts, gets a small seasonal pond. Lake on an island in a lake on an island in a lake.
It also has the largest island in a lake on an island in a lake -- Treasure Island in Mindemoya Lake on Manitoulin Island in Lake Huron.
